const imgCheck = "https://www.figma.com/api/mcp/asset/52720f16-a18f-4d82-a188-90399214d9a3.svg";

type CheckboxProps = {
  className?: string;
  state?: "Unchecked" | "Hover" | "Checked";
};

export default function Checkbox({ className, state = "Unchecked" }: CheckboxProps) {
  const isChecked = state === "Checked";
  const isHover = state === "Hover";
  return (
    <div className={className || `${String.raw`border-[length:var(--border-width\/emphasis,1.5px)] border-solid relative rounded-[var(--radius\/xs,5px)] size-[var(--size\/indicator,20px)] `}${isChecked ? String.raw`bg-[var(--color\/surface\/inverse,#111113)] border-[var(--color\/border\/selected,#111113)] content-stretch flex items-center justify-center` : isHover ? String.raw`bg-[var(--color\/background\/canvas,white)] border-[var(--color\/control\/indicator-hover,#8a8b8f)]` : String.raw`bg-[var(--color\/background\/canvas,white)] border-[var(--color\/control\/indicator,#b9b9b4)]`}`} id={isChecked ? "node-28_283" : isHover ? "node-28_282" : "node-28_281"}>
      {isChecked && (
        <div className="relative shrink-0 size-[12px]" data-node-id="28:284" data-name="Check">
          <img alt="" className="absolute block inset-0 max-w-none size-full" src={imgCheck} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
